title.blurb:
A rabbit who refuses to worship power. A rusty sword. Trials across Cuiling.
Story campaign · gear / soul / skill · postgame rifts.
title.controls:
WASD move · E interact · J parry · Esc pause
Autosave · Continue if you have a save.
tut.welcome: [Tutorial] Welcome to Greenvale. Click to skip each line.
tut.interact: [Interact] Yellow [E] appears near people/objects. Press E or Space.
tut.leave: [Goal] Talk to Maisui → pick up the rusty sword → leave via the eastern exit.
tut.battle: [Battle] Auto combat. Hits build Rage; full Rage casts a skill.
tut.parry: [Boss] When the center countdown turns green, press J or click to parry.
tut.done: Esc opens pause and save. Go.
tut.hud_hint: Goal: Maisui → Sword → East exit (E to interact)
tut.v2.boot1: Welcome to Cuiling. Take your time—the story can wait.
tut.v2.boot2: Controls: WASD move · E interact · J parry · Esc menu.
tut.v2.boot3: Esc has: daily reward, quests, guild, souls & skills.
tut.v2.explore1: Yellow prompts appear near people/objects. Press E.
tut.v2.explore2: Bottom tip shows your goal. Stuck? Esc → Journey.
tut.v2.battle_auto1: Trash fights auto-run. Damage builds Rage; full Rage auto-casts.
tut.v2.battle_auto2: Flee exits non-critical fights (not for bosses).
tut.v2.battle_parry1: Boss countdown: when it turns green, press J (or LMB) to parry.
tut.v2.battle_parry2: Perfect parry counters; miss hurts. Fire rings / wind also need J.
tut.v2.battle_parry3: One chance per wind-up. Spam whiffs. Early taps may still recover.
tut.v2.battle_fog1: White Fog has clones. Tab or 1/2/3 to lock target.
tut.v2.battle_fog2: Only hit the body when it flashes white. Phantoms bite back.
tut.v2.fort1: Three anchors in the fort: Ding forges gear, Star Reader souls, Greybeard skills.
tut.v2.fort2: Gear / Soul / Skill grow together—not a pick-one class.
tut.v2.fort3: Weapon path only sets feel. Gear, souls and skills each grow on their own.
tut.v2.forge1: Ding raises gear tiers with gold. Fails don't drop tier; streaks anger him.
tut.v2.forge2: Higher gear tier unlocks soul slots—souls socket into gear.
tut.v2.paths1: Path = how the weapon moves (sword/bow/magic/fist…), not who you are.
tut.v2.paths2: Switch paths for feel; gear tier, souls, and skills stay.
tut.v2.soul1: Star Reader spends Stardust to condense souls. Your path biases the chart.
tut.v2.soul2: Souls only buff after you slot them. Not a weapon path.
tut.v2.flag_hint1: A crooked rabbit mark on the plaza flag—walk up and press E.
tut.v2.ng1: NG+ (Blackflame Echo): harder foes, tighter windows; progress & looks carry over.
tut.v2.ng2: Echo layer is shown on UI. Some lines and notices change.
c0.intro1:
Greenvale should only know crickets and hearthfire.
Tonight a purple crack opens in the sky—blackflame falls from it.
c0.intro2: Blackflame is not normal fire. What it touches slowly 'vanishes', as if the world forgets it.
c0.intro3: Don't play hero! Run east—the stone-walled city still has lights.
c0.intro4: You stand empty-handed in the ash. Goal: the knight fortress to the east.
c0.maisui1: Don't freeze! Run east—the stone-walled fortress still has lights!
c0.maisui2: Why are you still standing here?
c0.choice_water: I'll fetch water to fight the fire—
c0.choice_help: (Offer a hand to help her up)
c0.reply_you: I'm taking my brother over the back hill. Don't follow—you're useless empty-handed. There's a sword on the ground. Grab it and run east.
c0.reply_water: The well is already dead! Water won't stop blackflame! Stop wasting time—sword, east, now!
c0.reply_help: …Thanks. I can stand. You need that sword more than I need a hand. Pick it up. Fortress is east.
c0.maisui3: Survive first. Sword on the ground east of here. Exit east too. Go!
c0.sword_have: The rusty sword is already in your hands. Heavy—but it cuts.
c0.sword1: A rusty sword sticks in the dirt. Heavier than you.
c0.sword2: You yank three times before it comes free.
c0.sword3: Got [Rusty Sword]. You can leave—east exit.
c0.wolf_spot: Breathing behind the brush—not human. Purple flame clings to it. You must pass.
flavor.hut_a: Half the roof is gone. Bowls still on the table—full of ash.
flavor.hut_b: The granary is empty. Grain wasn't carried off; it vanished like it was forgotten.
flavor.well: The well rope snapped. The water doesn't show your face—only a purple crack.
flavor.ash: The ash is still warm. Someone wrote a name here; the wind erased it.
flavor.cart: The cart flipped. The wheat in the split sacks is all black.
flavor.sign_east: Sign: 'East—stone-walled city. Don't look back.' The letters lean, as if written on the run.
flavor.milepost: Numbers scraped off the milepost. Only: 'However far—still the way home.'
flavor.bush: Purple light that shouldn't be on the leaf tips. Wind makes it sound like a quiet laugh.
flavor.road_stone: The road stone split. No grass in the crack—only ash.
flavor.dawn: Light in the east. Not the sun—the walls still bounce light back.
flavor.look_back: Smoke from the village still behind you. No turning back—only forward.
flavor.fire: Purple sparks still jump in the embers. Don't get close.
flavor.notice: Notice: 'Inner sanctum sealed. Holy Lion sleeps. No entry without order.' Charcoal circle; a crooked rabbit drawn beside it.
flavor.market: Stalls empty. A cloth still says 'fresh wheat'; the wind blurred the words.
flavor.forge_sign: The smith sign leans. Chalk below: 'Still open. Bring iron.'
flavor.fountain: The pool is dry. An old coin in the mud—knight order seal.
flavor.bench: The stone bench is cold. Someone sat long, then walked out of the city.
flavor.gate_arch: From the inner gate seam: not light—cold air.
flavor.scarecrow: Scarecrow burned to a frame. Empty brim faces the sanctum.
flavor.rubble: Claw marks on rubble—bigger than a wolf's.
flavor.trail: Fresh prints lead toward the sanctum.
